note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Jul 21 Google shipped three Flash models but NOT 3.5 Pro — another missed target (after May and Jul 17); DeepMind rebuilt the base model and is 'missing internal performance goals' (Bloomberg). Now 'testing with partners, land soon.' Polymarket ~41% by Aug 7, 77% by Aug 31.
Polymarket steady: 87% by Dec 31, 71% by Sep 30, 27% by Aug 31, ~1% by Jul 31. OpenAI's near-term line still flows through GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) and GPT-Live voice.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; markets price a next Claude Opus ~95% by Aug 31, ~98% by Oct 31, version unannounced.
xAI (now SpaceXAI) shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; markets price Grok 5 single-digit near-term (~16% before Sep). The 6T V9-foundation model reportedly still training on Colossus 2.
Google confirmed Jul 21 it has 'started its most ambitious pre-training run yet' for Gemini 4 — the next-gen flagship after 3.5 Pro. No date or dated market yet.
